S="${RR:?}/sandbox-runtime-use"; mkdir "$S/www" && printf 'nsr-sandbox-payload-8e2\n' > "$S/www/payload.txt" && cd "$S" || exit 2
python3 -u -m http.server 0 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory "$S/www" > "$S/server.log" 2>&1 &
V=$!
i=0; while [ $i -lt 40 ] && ! grep -q 'port [0-9]' "$S/server.log"; do sleep 0.25; i=$((i+1)); done
P=$(grep -o 'port [0-9]*' "$S/server.log" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
X=$(dirname "$(command -v srt)")
for m in allow deny empty; do
  python3 -c "import json,sys;r,m=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2];n={'allow':{'allowedDomains':['127.0.0.1'],'deniedDomains':[]},'deny':{'allowedDomains':['127.0.0.1'],'deniedDomains':['127.0.0.1']},'empty':{'allowedDomains':[],'deniedDomains':[]}}[m];json.dump({'network':n,'filesystem':{'denyRead':[],'allowWrite':[],'denyWrite':[]}},open(r+'/net-'+m+'.json','w'))" "$S" $m
  /usr/bin/env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$X:/usr/bin:/bin" srt --settings "$S/net-$m.json" curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 10 --retry 2 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 1 --noproxy "" "http://127.0.0.1:$P/payload.txt" > "$S/net-$m.out" 2>&1
  echo "$m=$?" >> "$S/net.rc"
done
kill $V; wait $V 2>/dev/null
n=$(grep -c 'GET /payload.txt' "$S/server.log")
echo "owned loopback HTTP server on an OS-assigned port | curl exits: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$S/net.rc")| allow returned payload: $(grep -c nsr-sandbox-payload-8e2 "$S/net-allow.out") | proxy 403 for deny/empty: $(grep -c 'error: 403' "$S/net-deny.out")/$(grep -c 'error: 403' "$S/net-empty.out") | requests that reached the server: $n"
grep -qx 'allow=0' "$S/net.rc" && grep -qx 'deny=22' "$S/net.rc" && grep -qx 'empty=22' "$S/net.rc" && grep -q nsr-sandbox-payload-8e2 "$S/net-allow.out" && grep -q 'error: 403' "$S/net-deny.out" && grep -q 'error: 403' "$S/net-empty.out" && test "$n" -eq 1
